test_case.test_name: Parameterized UBB board-level Redfish ThermalMetrics completeness and validity validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the platform-approved UBB ThermalMetrics resource returns a complete, current, numerically valid board-level thermal collection with no protocol or health error.
required_package: Approved BMC target/IP, HTTPS/authentication policy and least-privilege credentials
Per-field units, valid ranges, unavailable/null semantics and freshness limit
Ambient/load context plus correlated BMC health/log acceptance
test_case.test_command: Using the approved BMC transport and credentials, GET the exact `/redfish/v1/Chassis/UBB/ThermalMetrics` resource, retain headers/status and full JSON, validate every expected member against the project schema, units, range and freshness oracle, and correlate with the recorded ambient/load and BMC health. Do not silently fall back to `/Thermal`.
test_case.expected_result: The exact resource returns success with every expected UBB metric present, correctly typed and identified, current within the freshness limit, within its approved range/context, and without Redfish or BMC health error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact endpoint identity, complete sensor cardinality, schema/units/range/freshness validation and correlated health. HTTP success or plausible numbers alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Read-only query only; do not change BMC settings or clear logs.
Use approved TLS/authentication handling and protect credentials/output.
Treat missing, stale, null and unsupported members according to the approved schema, not as zero or PASS.
Abort on target/resource mismatch, authentication anomaly or schema drift; no guessed OEM fallback.
expected_evidence: HTTP status/headers and complete raw ThermalMetrics JSON
BMC health/log correlation and credential-safe command record
test_case.recovery: No DUT state changes are expected. On failure, preserve response/status/schema evidence and escalate to the BMC/UBB owner; do not retry with guessed OEM endpoints, change configuration or clear evidence.
